provenance.purpose: Original adapter control for collection parity; no solver is called by the test.

historical_unknowns: Exact executable/source build and producing input checksum
Ambient density/altitude and therefore exact IAS/TAS conversion
Initial Earth origin/attitude/control values or autoloaded .pnt/.set/.con
Historical computational mesh and nonlinear branch/iteration details
Exact sensor-flow toggle; induced flow is supported, not directly logged
qualifications: Original model bytes and exact commanded IAS/incidence are unchanged; no experiment or fitted parameter is used.
Reconstruction assumes speed equals commanded IAS at the declared atmosphere. Historical TAS, atmosphere, PG/KF settings and node arrays remain unknown.
Independent cold starts do not reproduce unknown historical continuation or nonlinear branch history.
Numerical validity, strict printed precision and two-mesh sensitivity are separate; no complete-family or historical-setting match is asserted.
job.reference_scope: All four printed sensor channels of all twelve sweeps for original [03_90], [m15_02]_S and [p15_02]_S models; supplemental span exports and other models remain outside this adapter.
